title_en: Forza Horizon 6, Skyrim, and More Microsoft-Published Games Are Getting Big Discounts in Best Buy’s Deal of the Day
summary_en: Best Buy has dropped big discounts on Starfield for PS5, Skyrim for Switch 2, and a few more Microsoft-published games, but only for today.
body_en:
For today only, Best Buy is offering up to 50% off a select few physical copies of Microsoft-published games across various platforms. This is part of the retailer's latest Deal of the Day drop, and there's some real treats shuffled in the mix, including Ninja Gaiden 4 on Xbox Series X , Skyrim on Switch 2 , Starfield on PS5 , Forza Horizon 6 on Xbox Series X , and Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3 + 4.
Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3 + 4 is actually the only one of the bunch that has multiple platforms discounted for the daily deal drop. Alongside PlayStation 5 , it's also on sale for Nintendo Switch and Xbox Series X at the same price of $25, so you can grab it for your preferred console.
All of these games are only on sale for the day, though, so the clock is ticking before Best Buy reshuffles to its next Deal of the Day selection. If one of these has been on your radar, don't miss out on this chance to grab it at a discounted price.
Each of these games is very deserving of a spot in your gaming library, too. We consider Skyrim to be an open world masterpiece you need to play , and the recently-released Forza Horizon 6 earned a glowing 10/10 review score from us earlier this year as well.
Both Ninja Gaiden 4 and Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3 + 4 weren't far behind Forza in terms of review scores, with each of them receiving 8s, and Starfield came just underneath them with a 7. Overall, that's a very exciting batch of well-thought-of games to have discounted right now, but again, not for very long. If one of them has caught your eye, now is the time to grab them before the deals run out after today at Best Buy.
These are certainly not the only game deals worth checking out right now, though. Nintendo's Customer Appreciation Sale is still live with plenty of discounts on Switch games. Or, if you prefer to play on PC, have a look at September's Humble Choice to see what games you can add to your Steam library.
Hannah Hoolihan is a freelancer who writes with the commerce team here at IGN.
